name: game-studio-sim
description: A crew protocol for game projects: four permanent roles, five checkpoints, and exactly one owner per decision.

interface.shortDescription: Run a small studio crew with explicit ownership
interface.longDescription: A collaboration protocol rather than an org chart: a director, designer, artist and engineer, plus a critic invoked at checkpoints. Every artifact has one owner and declared inputs, changes are priced against what they displace, and the critic must return a falsifiable defect or an explicit abstention. Built from documented game-project failure modes, not invented roles.
defaultPrompt: Start a game project and run the crew protocol
Write the checkpoint-1 brief for my game idea
